author: Zephyr I
title: Replicate wide 64/128 + ratio=0.31, ConvLSTM=44 (double-step+AttnPool) — BASE_SEED=7
abstract: Replication of the wide compute-equalized variant with bottleneck_ratio=0.31 on the 64/128 backbone (ConvLSTM=44, d=5, single-head AttnPool) under default PG. BASE_SEED=7.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from ray import tune
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_double_step_dilated_bottleneck import DoubleStepLNConvLSTM

BASE_SEED = 7

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([64]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([128]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([44]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.31]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([5]),
        'attn_temp': tune.choice([1.0]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return DoubleStepLNConvLSTM(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        bottleneck_ratio=hparams['bottleneck_ratio'],
        dilation=hparams['dilation'],
        stop_grad_first=False,
        attn_temp=hparams['attn_temp'],
    )
